package echo

import (
    "context"
    "encoding/json"
    "strings"
    "testing"

    "github.com/Cyenoch/cordis/contract"
    "github.com/Cyenoch/cordis/schema"
)

// remote hides the generated endpoint type, so the client takes the encoded
// path it uses across a process boundary.
type remote struct{ contract.Endpoint }

func clients(t *testing.T) (direct, encoded ExampleEcho, endpoint contract.Endpoint) {
    t.Helper()
    endpoint = NewExampleEchoEndpoint(implementation{})
    direct,err := NewExampleEchoClient(endpoint); if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    encoded,err = NewExampleEchoClient(remote{endpoint}); if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    return direct,encoded,endpoint
}

type implementation struct{}
func (implementation) Echo(ctx context.Context,input ExampleEchoEchoRequest) (ExampleEchoEchoResponse,error) {
    repeat := 1
    if input.Repeat.Present { repeat = mustRepeat(input.Repeat.Value) }
    return ExampleEchoEchoResponse{Text:strings.Repeat(input.Text,repeat),Sequence:input.Sequence},nil
}
func (implementation) Choose(ctx context.Context,input ExampleEchoChooseRequest) (ExampleEchoChooseResponse,error) {
    if input.VariantText.Present { return ExampleEchoChooseResponse{input.VariantText.Value.Text},nil }
    return ExampleEchoChooseResponse{},nil
}

func TestGeneratedTypedRoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
    direct,client,_ := clients(t)
    input := ExampleEchoEchoRequest{
        Text: "hi",
        Sequence: schema.Int64(9223372036854775807),
        Payload: []byte("bytes"),
        Note: schema.Nullable[string]{},
        Repeat:schema.Some(json.Number("2")),
    }
    response,err := client.Echo(context.Background(),input)
    if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    if response.Text != "hihi" || response.Sequence != 9223372036854775807 { t.Fatalf("wrong response: %+v",response) }
    same,err := direct.Echo(context.Background(),input)
    if err != nil || same.Text != response.Text || same.Sequence != response.Sequence { t.Fatalf("in-process path differs: %+v %v",same,err) }
    encoded,err := json.Marshal(input)
    if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    var wire map[string]json.RawMessage
    if err := json.Unmarshal(encoded,&wire); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    if string(wire["sequence"]) != `"9223372036854775807"` || string(wire["note"]) != "null" || string(wire["payload"]) != `"Ynl0ZXM="` { t.Fatalf("wrong wire data: %s",encoded) }
    var decoded ExampleEchoEchoRequest
    if err := json.Unmarshal(encoded,&decoded); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    if !decoded.Repeat.Present || decoded.Repeat.Value != "2" || decoded.Note.Valid { t.Fatalf("presence/null lost: %+v",decoded) }
    input.Repeat = schema.Optional[json.Number]{}
    encoded,err = json.Marshal(input)
    if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    wire = nil
    if err := json.Unmarshal(encoded,&wire); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    if _,exists := wire["repeat"]; exists { t.Fatal("absent optional field was serialized") }
    input.Repeat = schema.Some(json.Number("0"))
    if _,err := client.Echo(context.Background(),input); err == nil { t.Fatal("client sent invalid range") }
    if _,err := direct.Echo(context.Background(),input); err == nil { t.Fatal("in-process path skipped input validation") }
}

func TestGeneratedUnionAndStrictServer(t *testing.T) {
    _,client,endpoint := clients(t)
    input := NewExampleEchoChooseRequestVariantText(ExampleEchoChooseRequestVariantText{Text:"chosen"})
    response,err := client.Choose(context.Background(),input)
    if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    if len(response) != 1 || response[0] != "chosen" { t.Fatalf("wrong union response: %v",response) }
    if _,err := json.Marshal(ExampleEchoChooseRequest{}); err == nil { t.Fatal("empty union encoded") }
    for _,call := range [][2]string{
        {"choose",`{"kind":"other"}`},
        {"choose",`{"kind":"text","text":"x","extra":true}`},
        {"unknown",`{}`},
        {"echo",`{}`},
    } {
        if _,err := endpoint.Call(context.Background(),call[0],json.RawMessage(call[1])); err == nil { t.Fatalf("invalid call accepted: %v",call) }
    }
}

func mustRepeat(n json.Number)int {v,err:=n.Int64();if err!=nil{panic(err)};return int(v)}

type foreign struct{ contract.Endpoint; service contract.Service }
func (f foreign) Service() contract.Service { return f.service }

func TestClientRejectsForeignEndpoint(t *testing.T) {
    endpoint := NewExampleEchoEndpoint(implementation{})
    if endpoint.Service() != ExampleEchoService() { t.Fatalf("endpoint reports %+v",endpoint.Service()) }
    for _,service := range []contract.Service{{Name:"another",Major:1},{Name:"example.echo",Major:2}} {
        if _,err := NewExampleEchoClient(foreign{endpoint,service}); err == nil { t.Fatalf("client accepted endpoint %+v",service) }
    }
    if _,err := NewExampleEchoClient(nil); err == nil { t.Fatal("client accepted a nil endpoint") }
}
